nodes.label: Resume Ingestion (PDF to Qdrant)
nodes.rationale: LlamaIndex PDFReader extracts text, SentenceSplitter chunks at 1000 with 200 overlap so semantic context spans chunk boundaries, GPT-4o-mini extracts the profile, BGE-M3 embeds each chunk and chunks land in Qdrant with metadata.

nodes.label: Structured Candidate Profile Extraction
nodes.rationale: GPT-4o-mini output is validated with Pydantic so a malformed or hallucinated profile fails fast instead of propagating into scoring.

nodes.label: Deterministic Candidate-Job Scoring Algorithm
nodes.rationale: overall = skill*0.40 + experience*0.20 + education*0.10 + semantic*0.30, with required skills at 70% and preferred at 30%, graded experience bands (>=required 100%, within 2y 90%, within 5y 80%, else proportional), graded education bands (100/70/40/10) and semantic as mean cosine similarity of the top 10 chunks. Deterministic rather than LLM-judged so the same inputs always yield the same score and rankings are auditable.

nodes.label: Evidence-Based RAG Summary with Reranking
nodes.rationale: Retrieve top 20 chunks, rerank with BGE-reranker-v2-m3 to top 10, keep the top 5 as evidence, then have GPT-4o-mini write a grounded summary. Two-stage retrieve-then-rerank raises precision while keeping the LLM context small, and attaching evidence chunks makes the explanation checkable.

nodes.label: Deterministic Candidate Ranking
nodes.rationale: Ranking reuses already-stored MatchScores sorted by overall_score descending and only then attaches RAG explanations, so ordering never depends on LLM output.

nodes.label: resume_chunks Qdrant Collection Schema
nodes.rationale: 1024-dim cosine vectors keyed by candidate_id, resume_id, nullable job_id, chunk_id, section, source_pdf, text, metadata and created_at; the keyword fields exist so retrieval can be filtered to one candidate before similarity search.

nodes.label: Model Configuration (BGE-M3, GPT-4o-mini, Qwen3)
nodes.rationale: Qwen3-Embedding-8B is kept as a reference/foundation model while BGE-M3 does the actual embedding work and GPT-4o-mini handles extraction, summaries and explanations - a cheap small LLM is sufficient because scoring itself is deterministic.

nodes.label: Inngest Workflow Definitions
nodes.rationale: candidate/ingest-resume, candidate/score-job, candidate/rag-summary and job/rank-candidates run every long operation asynchronously with retries and idempotency, so a failed LLM or embedding step is retried rather than surfaced to the HTTP caller.

nodes.label: Stateless AI Service Design
nodes.rationale: 'The AI service does not store candidate, job, or user data. It only processes AI tasks.' It reads profiles and job descriptions from Spring Boot and POSTs MatchScore, RAGSummary and RankingResult back, so Spring Boot stays the single system of record and tenancy/auth never has to be duplicated in Python.

nodes.label: AI Service Monitoring & Observability
nodes.rationale: Structured JSON logging via structlog plus a health endpoint reporting dependency status, with the Inngest and Qdrant dashboards covering workflow and vector-store metrics instead of a bespoke metrics stack.
